description: Dry-run one of the user's price alerts against the latest price for its commodity: reports the condition, the latest price and its timestamp, whether the alert would trigger now, and whether it is in its cooldown window. Nothing is sent and the alert is not changed. Use when the user wants to check an alert is set correctly before relying on it. Get the id from opa_list_price_alerts. REQUIRES an API key (OILPRICEAPI_KEY); the call reads a live price, so it counts against the account's request quota like a data request.

id.description: The numeric id of the alert to test, as returned by opa_list_price_alerts or opa_create_price_alert (e.g. '1234').

name: opa_test_price_alert
title: Test Price Alert
